claims.text: Moderate to severe extraglandular manifestations need systemic tx:
claims.quote: However, moderate to severe extraglandular manifestations call for systemic therapy.

claims.text: GCs, antimalarials (eg, HCQ), steroid-sparing immunosuppressants (MTX, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, leflunomide);
claims.quote: In such cases, glucocorticoids, antimalarial medication (eg, hydroxychloroquine), and steroid-sparing immunosuppressants, including methotrexate, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, or leflunomide, may be used.
Rituximab or cyclophosphamide may be considered occasionally.
